lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Large, high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern. Approximately four horizontal rows are visible, with spots aligned vertically to form rectangular coordinates across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, with each major blob serving as a central anchor node within the vertical stripe's width.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal aspect and localized shadowing on the ventral aspect of each ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of spots and a secondary labyrinthine pattern of fine, high-luminance lines near the proximal base.
